svg.title: The native and tuned configurations give the same 8K-input limit
svg.desc: Four groups show three p95 time-to-first-token trials each for the 8K-input 1K-output workload. The native 262K-context configuration and tuned 12K-context configuration both pass concurrency seven near 8.7 seconds and fail concurrency eight near 10.67 seconds, with the ten-second SLO marked.
